entries.canonical_text: The AI systems sent to the island had no specific tasks or rewards. But their initial settings guided them to be curious, explore, and learn. They had no homework, but they were in exploration mode.
entries.primary_text: The AI systems sent to the island had no specific tasks or rewards, but their initial setting guided them to be curious, explore, and learn. They had no homework, but they were in exploration mode.

entries.canonical_text: Still, this changes how we see a detour. A discovery that is no use right now might become a useful card to play next time, if it is saved. If you see an AI jumping around on the island, pay attention to its notes as well as its feet. Its next tower might depend on a discovery written down in just one line.
